title: Add Profile Page with Channel Info and Fix View Count Logic

requirements.text: Add a Profile tab to the bottom navigation bar (alongside Home, Upload, Shorts, Subscriptions) that navigates to the authenticated user's own profile page.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Profile' tab with a user/person icon appears in the BottomNav component.
Tapping the Profile tab navigates to the current user's channel profile page.
The Profile tab shows an active indicator when the profile route is active.
Unauthenticated users see a prompt to sign in when tapping the Profile tab.

requirements.text: Create a dedicated User Profile page that displays the authenticated user's profile information (display name, channel name, principal ID) and channel statistics (total videos uploaded, total views, total likes received), along with a grid of the user's uploaded videos and photos.

quotes: jahan channel ki aur profile ki jankari hoti h

acceptanceCriteria: The profile page shows the user's display name and channel name prominently.
Channel stats (video count, total views, total likes) are displayed as stat cards.
A grid of the user's uploaded videos is shown below the profile info.
A grid or section for the user's uploaded photos is also shown.
A link or button to navigate to Settings (to edit profile) is present.
Unauthenticated users see a sign-in prompt instead of profile content.

requirements.text: Add a '/profile' route to the router that renders the new User Profile page for the currently authenticated user.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to '/profile' renders the User Profile page.
The route is registered in App.tsx alongside existing routes.
The page reuses existing hooks (useGetCallerUserProfile, useUserStats, useVideos, usePhotos) to populate data.

requirements.text: Ensure video view counts increment only when an authenticated user has actively watched the video — the view count increment must be triggered after a minimum watch threshold (e.g., at least 5 seconds of playback), not on page load or when the video is merely loaded in the DOM.

quotes: video ke views automatically badh rahe h keval agar koi user ise dekhta h tabhi views count hone chahiye

acceptanceCriteria: The useIncrementVideoView mutation is called only after the video has been played for at least 5 seconds.
View count does NOT increment on page load or on video mount without playback.
View count does NOT increment for unauthenticated (anonymous) users.
View count increments at most once per page visit, even if the video is rewound or replayed.
A timeupdate or onPlaying event listener is used to track actual playback duration before triggering the increment.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Reuse existing hooks (useGetCallerUserProfile, useUserStats, useVideos, usePhotos, useChannelName) instead of creating redundant ones.
View count increment logic must remain authenticated-only as currently enforced in useIncrementVideoView.
nonGoals: Editing profile information from the new Profile page (that remains in Settings).
Subscription management on the Profile page.
Public profile pages for other users (only the current user's own profile is in scope).
Backend changes to the view count logic — the fix is purely in when the frontend triggers the mutation.
